measured.cost_scope: cost_usd and span-based figures describe dispatched agents; coordinator cost is recorded separately: Arch self-reported 325 min, cost unknown (coordinator.self_reported; not added to cost_usd)

problems.summary: Rewording a runtime error message silently broke a test that greps it, and the break was invisible to every suite run during four correction rounds.
problems.evidence: The round-0 reader commit changed RNF_NC_ERROR's operation string from the literal 'opening the file' to a composed 'opening ' // fileNam, so the model emits 'opening <filename> failed'. tests/rnf/placement_probe.py detects step 1 of every probe run by the old sentence, so all four probe runs returned at step 1 with 0 probes and map None, control included. Caught at command 9 of 57 by the final verification, after BOTH reviewers had approved. placement_probe is scientific-only (1 of 57, in neither the 9 focused nor the 1 structural) because it needs three cs32 MPI builds, so no correction round could structurally have found it.

problems.summary: A reported test figure came from a binary predating its own source edit, and was caught only because the implementer checked build mtimes unprompted.
problems.evidence: '54 of 54 on --mpi 2' was measured on lab_sea/build_esx_mpi2 dated 05:18, predating the 08:56 edit to rnf_time_setup.F. The edit was comment-only so the behaviour was identical, but the number's provenance was not established. The implementer rebuilt rather than argue the premise and re-measured to 54 of 54 at 10:05:43; review B then verified both the mtime ordering and a fresh sealed execution on that binary. Review B separately found the symmetric flaw in its own reuse method: comparing two sealed reports' reference-hash maps cannot distinguish an added citation from a modified file, and it had reported an empty changed set on that basis in round 3.

problems.summary: A test built specifically to discriminate wrong Gregorian anchorings was blind to the anchoring the implementation's own shape makes most likely to be wrong.
problems.evidence: The implementer enumerated three nominal-year readings and chose the shortest span separating all three. Review B found a fourth — re-dating record 1 into the model's START year and wrapping from there, which is what RNF_TIME_SETUP resolving RNF_recDate1 once at init invites — which the chosen span separates by EXACTLY 0.0, because 1980-01-16 12:00 is exactly two 365-day cycles after the file's record 1. Moving the span to 1981-12-01 separates all four at 2.247404e-02 for the same run cost.

problems.summary: Eleven of the twelve must-fix items were defects in claims about the work, not in the work; the time handling was correct in all five modes from the first dispatch.
problems.evidence: A header date (1980-02-29 for a parting the measurement puts at 1981-01-01) and a citation to a test file that does not exist; a 'three ways' completeness claim falsified by a fourth; a guard called unreachable that review B fired in 1.0 s; a guard census understated as 3 unenrolled when it was 8; three stale Coverage limits passages; the governing contract still naming a superseded oracle; two conflicting counts in one matrix row; and a repository count of 199 that was a count of a truncated hits list. Arch contributed two of these — a mischaracterised tool limit and a misattribution of a figure across two issues.

problems.summary: Four correction rounds on a two-round budget, the last for a genuine regression and the third for a single clause.
problems.evidence: Rounds 1-3 were claim defects with no code impact; round 4 was the placement_probe regression. Review A declined to treat round 3 as a stalled loop, noting the trend was converging (four items, then one, then one clause) and offering a minimal alternative rather than demanding a full round. The overrun is accounted for rather than hidden; the alternative was closing with documents that disagreed with the code.

problems.summary: A fifth agent turn died on a provider API error, and the Slack provider has been absent for eleven consecutive iterations with the gate demanding a re-probe each time.
problems.evidence: Bob's first RUNOFF-005 dispatch terminated on 'the response stopped arriving' while starting RNF_TIME_SETUP, losing only an uncommitted header edit — the third such failure this session. Separately, claude mcp list has reported no MCP servers for eleven iterations across three issues; the outage was renewed twice when its 5-iteration bound expired, and the retained queue is now 25 events.

solutions.reference: tests/rnf/placement_probe.py OPEN_FAILED plus the coverage-limits item of docs/verification_matrix.md
solutions.reason: Detection is now a compiled pattern pinning the routine, the verb and the probe file rather than a sentence with a variable embedded in it, with PROBE_FILE a single definition driving both the namelist and the matcher so they cannot drift. The model message is kept, because naming the file is necessary once RNF_FILE_NAME resolves <base>_YYYY.nc. Review A tested the pattern against seven wrong stops for 0 mismatches and ran the probe to 4 of 4 with every per-layout figure equal to its RUNOFF-033 values; the implementer proved the pattern was the whole defect by restoring only the old literal and reproducing the failure exactly. The implementer's own framing is the lesson: rewording a runtime message is an interface change, and it had treated it as cosmetic.

solutions.reference: lessons_learned.md LL-011 with its evidence entry
solutions.reason: Recorded as a lesson in both its forms, because the same error appeared on both sides: state build and source mtimes beside any figure that depends on a compiled binary and check the ordering before the run; rebuild rather than reason from the nature of the change, since 'comment-only' establishes behaviour and not provenance; and to reuse earlier evidence confirm the bytes with a direct diff against a named commit rather than inferring it from a comparison of reference sets.

solutions.reference: tests/rnf/timing_field_check.py cal_start 19811201 and the enrolled start_year variant
solutions.reason: The implementer took BOTH remedies where either would have satisfied the item — enrolled the fourth anchoring and moved the span — so all four now discriminate at 2.247404e-02, and demonstrated the new guard firing by re-running on the old span, where start_year reads exactly 0.0 and the case fails while the dense-vs-sparse comparison still passes. The completeness claim is replaced by an explicit statement that the list is measured, not complete. Review B verified the enrolled variant is bit-identical to its own implementation over all 1800 dates of both spans.

solutions.reference: lessons_learned.md LL-010 with its evidence entry, plus the four scope decisions of this closeout
solutions.reason: The durable part is LL-010 on replacing an unachievable criterion by measurement and recording what the replacement does not cover. The decisive instrument is recorded there: perturb the input by the smallest representable amount and show the criterion already fails — a 1-ulp runoff_flux change collapsed a case from 16 digits to 4, which both proved the digit oracle unachievable and excluded a masked defect, and measurement also caught the claim being too broad since month and clim do meet it at 16 digits.

solutions.reference: the agent_continuity note and the scope decisions of devel-loop/loop_state/issue-done.json
solutions.reason: Accounted for in the closed record with what each round bought: rounds 1-3 corrected claims, round 4 a regression that only the final suite could reach. Review A's judgement that a converging sequence is not a stalled loop is recorded, and the alternative — closing with documents that disagreed with the code, and with a test that silently detected nothing — was worse than the overrun.

Provider transport failures are outside this project's control and the resume path lost only an uncommitted header edit, so no project-side change is warranted; recorded so the pattern across iterations stays visible rather than being absorbed each time. The absent Slack provider is a host configuration gap with a standing authorization and a one-command fix available to the owner; it is recorded in the closeout communication disposition and the queue retains all 25 events, so nothing is lost by the delay.

confirmations.summary: A final verification owned by someone who neither wrote nor reviewed the code caught a regression that four correction rounds and six reviewer confirmations missed.
confirmations.evidence: placement_probe is 1 of 57 scientific commands and appears in neither the 9 focused nor the 1 structural suite, because it needs three cs32 MPI builds. Both reviewers had approved. Review A confirmed from esx/project.json that no correction round could structurally have found it. This is the second time this session the scientific suite caught something every focused run missed.

confirmations.summary: Three of the four substantive defects found after the first approval came from a reviewer re-measuring something that already looked settled, not from new analysis.
confirmations.evidence: Review A's own observation. The clim_long blind span, the 199 that turned out to be a count of a truncated list, and the placement_probe regression were each surfaced by re-measurement rather than by the tooling announcing a problem. The same pattern produced both framework findings of this session — the ast.dump interpreter coupling and the stale-hits truncation.

confirmations.summary: Every party corrected at least one other, and three corrected themselves on the record.
confirmations.evidence: The implementer corrected review B's sinc identity to a latitude-dependent ratio, and review B verified and conceded. Review B traced the census discrepancy to its own miscount and supplied the bridge. Review A retracted its own diagnosis of the stale seal, corrected its own census undercount from 13 to 14, and corrected the stated basis of its own reuse method. Arch corrected a mischaracterised tool limit and a figure misattributed across two issues. Each correction rested on a measurement rather than on deference.

confirmations.summary: An implementer discarded its own sweep method rather than report a figure it could not defend, and reframed to a sharper question.
confirmations.evidence: A static reconstruction of every WRITE(msgBuf) message produced 23 mostly-false positives. Rather than publish the number, it asked which literals weaken SILENTLY rather than loudly, identified refusal_check's forbid lists as the silent class, and answered with a 14/8/6 census that both reviewers reproduced exactly — while marking the weaker half of its own evidence as weaker.

carry_forward: RUNOFF-017 carries the forbid-class work: a one-line start-up assertion that every forbid literal also appears in some case's positive expectation, which makes the class non-vacuous by construction instead of by an audit that decays; plus review A's grading refinement (five of the six unwitnessed literals are single definitions used on both sides, stronger than a log witness; the one real residual is the duplicated raw string 'fraction sum is not 1'), and that a forbid can go vacuous with no rewording at all if its condition stops being reachable.

RUNOFF-006 carries the no-pkg/cal path this issue implemented but could not exercise, plus three review-B items: the 1e-3 repeat-cycle tolerance against GET_PERIODIC_INTERVAL's exact test, the inherited +0.5 s hold-exact rounding (both faithfulness to pkg/exf, so changing either would make the sparse path diverge from the dense oracle), and raising --min-discrimination from 5e-3 to about 2e-2.

placement_probe is scientific-only, so its findings arrive only at closure. If a lighter layout case can be built that does not need three cs32 MPI builds, one belongs in the focused suite; otherwise the matrix should keep recording that the probe protects no correction round.

Still unexecuted after this issue: the no-pkg/cal time path and its three unenrolled refusals (rnf_time_setup.F 491, 497, 579), rnf_getrec.F's two stops (204, 277), the exch2 fold and long-line placement branches, maskInC = 0, kTopC != 0 (never compiled), blank exch2 tiles, multi-threaded runs, LLC, and the two cell-centre skip paths.
The nominal-year anchoring list is measured, not complete: four are written down and measured, and a fifth would need its own measurement. The documents say so in four places.

TEAM-DOCCONTRACT-AST-DUMP-DIGEST-001 and TEAM-DOCCONTRACT-STALE-HITS-TRUNCATION-001 are both open framework findings in the same tool, both surfaced by a reviewer re-measuring something settled. RUNOFF-034 and RUNOFF-035 also remain open from RUNOFF-033.
